description: Set the authenticated user's fun score (1-100) for a game. Upserts — calling again overwrites. Also updates the score attached to any existing written review. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

name: kineticist_set_fun_score
title: Set your fun score
